name: sprite_builder_create_build
description: Trigger a build: Docker-build the project's repo in a fresh sprites.dev sandbox and run it to get a live URL. Omit commit_sha to build HEAD of the project's default branch, or pass a specific commit_sha. Returns a Build in status 'queued'; poll sprite_builder_get_build until 'succeeded' (url is set) or 'failed'. Set any needed env vars (sprite_builder_set_env) BEFORE building.

project_id.description: The project's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_list_projects / sprite_builder_create_project).

commit_sha.description: Optional explicit commit SHA. Omitted = HEAD of the default branch.
